question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Fixation
solution: The correct answer is '**Indifference'**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Antonyms are words with opposite meanings. • **Fixation **means a strong attachment or obsession with something. (किसी चीज़ के प्रति गहरा लगाव या जुनून) • **Example**: *Her fixation on collecting vintage stamps led her to search for rare pieces at every opportunity.* • Marked option **Indifference** means lack of interest or concern. (रुचि या चिंता की कमी) • **Example**: *Despite the exciting news, his indifference to the project was evident as he barely reacted to the announcement.* • Therefore, indifference is the most appropriate antonym for fixation. Hence, **option 2** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Formulation** means the process of creating or developing something. (किसी चीज़ को बनाने या विकसित करने की प्रक्रिया) • **Inclination **means a tendency or preference towards something. (किसी चीज़ के प्रति प्रवृत्ति या प्राथमिकता) • **Reformation **means the act of improving or changing something for the better. (किसी चीज़ को बेहतरी के लिए सुधारने या बदलने की क्रिया) 47:T970, The correct answer is: **Orbit**
